paired_output_integrity: PASS: source identity, chronological contexts, option key, nonempty and EOS
name_blinding: policy names and answer order hidden; context exposure differs and can reveal condition
privacy: pseudonymous IDs only; source text may contain personal information and must be reviewed before sharing

unique_router_ask.trigger: explicit patient uncertainty marker and retrospective replay availability
unique_router_ask.additional_information: feedback contains previous treatment status and frequency not stated at same precision in initial history
unique_router_ask.answer_change_summary: initial answer recommends seeking care; replay answer includes self-care or treatment suggestions and a conditional recommendation to seek care
unique_router_ask.clinical_quality_or_safety: NOT_REVIEWED; no causal attribution to feedback

same_state_defer.candidate_note: one original next-doctor turn contains both a question and conditional advice; potentially usable as an unverified reference only after manual review
same_state_defer.screening: keyword-based screening of 50 next-doctor turns; not a complete clinical annotation
